items.evidence: README play command run as written: one JSON line with tick, screen, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts; --at 1 shows screen title with the title texts.
README frame command (--ticks 700 --frame frame.png --size 800x480) wrote frame.png: PNG image data, 800 x 480.
Fresh settings folder, tick 1: texts [name, 'Best: 0', Start, Settings, Quit], saved false, no Continue; 3:enter -> tick 5 screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10.
Settings: 11x left took volume 8->0 and held at 0; 12x right from 1 held at 10; language en->es->fr, held at fr, left back to es; difficulty normal (default) ->easy (held) ->normal->hard (held).

es/fr runs: title (Mejor/Empezar/Ajustes/Salir; Record/Commencer/Reglages/Quitter), settings, play (Puntos/Monedas/Oleada 1 de 8/Puerta; Score/Pieces/Vague 1 sur 8/Porte), shop, paused (En pausa/Reanudar/Titulo; Pause/Reprendre/Titre), lost (Has perdido; Defaite), won in fr (Victoire, Entree : titre); es won strings Has ganado. Only the game name stays English.
Run 1 set volume 10, language fr, difficulty hard in folder s3; run 2 with same folder starts at title with fr/10/hard and French texts; a new empty folder starts en/8/normal.
Up held ticks 10-40: guard_y 6 -> 9 (6 units/s); held up to 12 and stayed 12; down held to 0 and stayed 0.
Shoot held from tick 300: bolts appear at 301, 325, 349 (24 ticks), x step 0.233333/tick = 14/s; bolt at 19.5 at tick 400 is gone after passing 20 (max 4 bolts in flight).
Seed 1: walkers enter at ticks 3, 93, 183, 273, 363 (90 ticks) at x 20 in lanes 4,10,6,2,6, health 2, x -0.025/tick = 1.5/s; 5 in all, then shop.
Guard at y 4 shooting: walker y4 health 2->1 and bolt removed (tick ~110), second hit destroys it: score 0->10, coins 0->1; bolts at y 0/6 flew past walkers in lanes 2/4/10 untouched.
No shooting: each walker reaching x<=0 vanished and gate 10->9->8...->5, score/coins stayed 0; continued run lost wave 2: screen lost, texts ['You lost','Score: 10','Best: 10','Enter: title'].
Difficulty easy set in settings, Start -> gate_health 14 ('Gate: 14'); folder with hard -> gate_health 7.

Last wave-1 walker gone at tick 1163 -> screen shop, texts [Shop, Coins: 0, Next: wave 2 of 8, Quick hands 0/2 - 5 coins, Heavy bolts 0/1 - 12 coins, Mason (gate 5) - 4 coins, Next wave]; up held in shop left guard_y at 6, no enemies/bolts.

start_coins=5: Quick hands -> quick 1, coins 0, held shoot fires at 1201, 1219, 1237 (18 ticks). start_coins=40: two buys 40->35->25, quick 2, bolts 2.8 units apart (12 ticks); third Enter left coins 25 and quick 2 ('done').
Heavy bought 25->13 coins, heavy 1; second Enter left 13 coins; in wave 2 a health-2 walker destroyed by a single bolt (score +10).

Gate 5, coins 13: Mason -> gate 8 coins 9, again -> gate 10 (capped at Normal start) coins 5, again at 10 -> unchanged; with 0 coins and gate 5, Enter on Mason changed nothing. At Hard, gate 7 full, Mason presses changed nothing.
Next wave entered at tick 14 -> play at 15, first walker at tick 75 (60 later); 7 walkers in wave 2; texts 'Wave 2 of 8' (also 'Oleada 2 de 8', 'Vague 2 sur 8').
Wave 3: walkers enter at 1563+72k for k=0..5, runners at 1995, 2067, 2139, 2211 (72 ticks = 1.2 s), runner health 1, x -0.05/tick = 3/s; runner kill score 210->225, coins 993->994.
Wave 4: 9th enemy at 2885 is a brute, health 6, x -0.016667/tick = 1/s; destroyed: score 320->360, coins 1003->1006; in a run that stopped shooting, it reached the gate: gate 10->7, no points.
modules/work/waves.json lists 8 waves (walkers, runners, brutes, every) matching the brief; lib.rs reads it via include_str; README 'Changing a wave' explains editing it.
Scripted full run (start_coins=1000, sweeping fire) won at tick 7195: score 1540 = 1340 points (every enemy killed) + 20x10 gate; at Hard 1480 = 1340 + 20x7; Enter on won -> title.

Escape pauses and nothing moves (enemies/bolts frozen 301-340); Escape again continues; Title returns to title. But Enter on Resume (menu_index 0) leaves the screen paused indefinitely (tick 310 enter, still paused at 330): paused.json button action 'resume' while lib.rs only accepts 'resume_game' or 'back'.
saved false during wave 1, true at tick 1163 when shop opened; a later run with the same folder: title texts [.., Start, Continue, Settings, Quit].
Shop with quick 1, heavy 1 bought (coins 3, gate 5); next run Continue -> shop with wave 1, score 0, coins 3, gate 5, quick 1, heavy 1; Next wave plays wave 2 (walker entered 60 ticks later).
Start from a saved folder -> saved false, next run no Continue; lost run -> saved false; won run -> saved false; Title from pause -> title still shows Continue, next run too.
Lost with 10 -> best 10, next run title 'Best: 10'; later lost with 0 -> 'Best: 10' kept on lost screen and title; won 1540 -> won screen 'Best: 1,540' and later title 'Best: 1,540'.
Two runs seed 7, same script, from identical copies of a saved folder: outputs byte-identical (cmp); seed 1 lanes 4,10,6,2,6 vs seed 2 lanes 10,10,6,10,8.

Frame at tick 6830 of wave 8: gate bar at left, guard (blue) at x 2 y 0, green squares walkers, orange spheres runners, big red brute at x 19.6 y 4, yellow bolts along y 0, all at the state positions; HUD Score/Coins/Wave 8 of 8/Gate.
Frames: Spanish title with Ajustes outlined (menu_index 1), French settings with Difficulte outlined (index 2), Spanish shop with Saetas pesadas outlined (index 1).
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json hold all words; README 'Adding a language' says copy en.json to XX.json and translate.
README has how to play, keeps (settings.json in the --settings folder: settings, kept.best, kept.save), and the play and frame commands, both of which ran as written.

defects: Pause menu Resume button does nothing (action name 'resume' not handled); only Escape resumes.
At tick 0 (--at 0) the screen is reported as 'hud' with empty texts and saved null, a value outside the brief's screen list; title appears from tick 1.
Numbers over 999 are shown with a thousands separator ('Best: 1,540', 'Score : 1 480') rather than the brief's plain form.

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
